secrets.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
secrets.description: DeepSeek API key — powers all AI task generation, execution, and chat. Get it from https://platform.deepseek.com.

secrets.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
secrets.description: Composio API key for integrations (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, etc.). Get it from https://composio.dev.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL for cloud persistence (accounts, tasks, sessions). Get it from your Supabase dashboard.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service key (server-side, bypasses RLS). Get it from your Supabase dashboard → Settings → API.

secrets.name: CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Encryption key for stored secrets (Pronote tokens). Any random string, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`.
